definitions.explanation: A chair with wheels used by people who have difficulty walking.

examples.japanese: {車椅子|くるまいす}を{使|つか}っています。
この{建物|たてもの}は{車椅子|くるまいす}でも{入|はい}れます。
examples.english: This building is accessible by wheelchair.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{足|あし}を{怪我|けが}してから{車椅子|くるまいす}で{生活|せいかつ}しています。
examples.english: My grandmother has been living in a wheelchair since she injured her leg.

notes:
{車椅子|くるまいす} is a compound of {車|くるま} (wheel/vehicle) and {椅子|いす} (chair).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {車椅子|くるまいす}に{乗|の}る (to ride in a wheelchair)
- {車椅子|くるまいす}を{押|お}す (to push a wheelchair)
- {車椅子|くるまいす}{用|よう}のスロープ (wheelchair ramp)
